headline: Chip and AI Stocks Turn Lower by Lunch

writeup.headline: Chip and AI Stocks Turn Lower by Lunch
writeup.summary: This morning's big story was Oil Drops Below $100 on Iran Diplomacy Reports. The big swing: chip and AI stocks rallied early, then turned around after 10:28 AM and are now lower on the day — Crypto Briefing points to “AMD set to report Q3 results as AI hopes collide with a chip selloff”. The AI names are down and the average stock is up: money is rotating out of the AI giants into the rest of the market. Cyclical sectors are leading defensive ones, and the S&P has stayed under pressure.

themes.headline: Chip and AI stocks flipped from up to down
themes.detail: Up 1.9% at 10:28 AM, now -1.9%; hardest hit since: Advanced Micro Devices, Oracle. In the news: “AMD set to report Q3 results as AI hopes collide with a chip selloff” (Crypto Briefing).

themes.headline: S&P has stayed under pressure
themes.detail: Low at 2:48 PM, high at 10:27 AM; -0.5% since the open.
